full_judgment: 3. The Defendants appeared and contested the suit by filing written statements denying the allegations made in the plaint stating that the suit properties originally belonged to Hazi Karim Mondal who died leaving behind 3 sons Yeakub, Hashem Uddin and Mokbul Hossain, only daughter Ayton Bibi and his wife. Mokbul Hossain died before his father, leaving behind his only daughter. Plaintiff is entitled to a share of 1/3  share of the suit land. Thereafter, the contesting parties disclosed their desire for partition of the suit land and accordingly on 19.8.1976 the contesting parties executed and registered amicable partition deed No. 8820 dated 19.4.1976 and accordingly plaintiff is possessing her share and mutated his name. After registration plaintiff sold .88 acres of land and gifted .33 acres of land to her uncle Hashemuddin and the plaintiff mutated her name in the khatian and also sold some of the suit land to different persons. Plaintiff instituted the suit by violating the terms and condition of the partition deed with a false allegations and the suit is liable to be dismissed.
